# Intellipaat

> Intellipaat is a comprehensive online learning platform offering professional certification courses, degree programs, and corporate training in emerging technologies like data science, AI, cloud computing, and cybersecurity, partnering with top institutions like IIT Roorkee, NIT Sikkim, and IIM Ranchi.

Intellipaat provides both self-paced and instructor-led courses ranging from short certifications to full master's degrees, with a strong focus on job placement support and career transitions for working professionals. The platform combines academic rigor with industry-relevant skills through partnerships with premier Indian institutes and international universities.

## Key Topics

- Machine Learning
- Data Science
- Artificial Intelligence
- Cloud Computing
- Python
- DevOps
- Cyber Security
- IIT Roorkee
- NIT Sikkim
- IIM Ranchi
- Job Placement
- Executive Education
- Professional Certification
- Career Development
- Online Learning

## Core Programs & Certifications

- [Data Science Course Online with IIT Certification](https://intellipaat.com/data-scientist-course-training): Data science course with IIT Roorkee certification covering Python, ML, AI with placement support
- [Advanced Certification in DevOps and Cloud Computing - IIT Faculty](https://intellipaat.com/advanced-certification-devops-cloud-computing): Advanced DevOps and AWS certification bootcamp from IIT Madras with hands-on projects
- [Generative AI and Machine Learning Course - IIT Certification](https://intellipaat.com/generative-ai-machine-learning-course): Generative AI and ML course from IIT Indore covering prompt engineering, Python, deep learning
- [Executive Post Graduate Certification in Cyber Security - iHUB IIT Roorkee](https://intellipaat.com/epgc-ethical-hacking-ihub-iit-roorkee): Cybersecurity and ethical hacking bootcamp from IIT Roorkee iHUB with job placement
- [EPG Certification in Data Science and AI - IIT Roorkee iHUB](https://intellipaat.com/epgc-data-science-ai-ihubds-iit-roorkee): EPG certification in data science and AI from IIT Roorkee iHUB with job placement support
- [EPGC in Electric Vehicle Design - IIT Roorkee iHUB](https://intellipaat.com/epgc-electric-vehicle-design-ihub-iit-roorkee): EPGC in electric vehicle design from IIT Roorkee covering powertrain, EV charging, MATLAB
- [Product Management Course by IIM Ranchi](https://intellipaat.com/product-management-course-certification): Product management certification from IIM Ranchi covering strategy, agile, tools with alumni status
- [Chief Human Resources Officer (CHRO) - IIM Ranchi](https://intellipaat.com/chro-course): CHRO certification from IIM Ranchi for HR leadership covering talent management strategies

## Degree & Master's Programs

- [M.Tech in Computer Science (Executive) from NIT Sikkim](https://intellipaat.com/mtech-computer-science-nit-sikkim): Executive M.Tech from NIT Sikkim in AI, cybersecurity, full stack, cloud computing online
- [M.Sc in Applied AI (Online) by NIT Sikkim](https://intellipaat.com/msc-applied-ai): Online M.Sc in Applied AI from NIT Sikkim covering ML, DL, NLP with weekend classes
- [MS in Data Science & AI in Europe](https://intellipaat.com/ms-data-science-europe): MS in data science and AI from EU Global partner with WES recognition and EMI financing
- [Doctor of Business Administration Degree Program](https://intellipaat.com/doctor-of-business-administration): DBA degree from Swiss School of Business and Management Geneva with online learning
- [Intellipaat School of Technology IST](https://intellipaat.com/ist): 4-year undergraduate program from Intellipaat School of Technology with IIT faculty

## Specialized Programs & Research

- [AI & Data Science from DRISHTI CPS, IIT Indore](https://intellipaat.com/ai-data-science-drishti-iit-indore): AI and data science program from IIT Indore DRISHTI CPS with academic credits for undergraduates

## Learning Platforms & Services

- [Online Professional Training Courses and Certification](https://intellipaat.com): Intellipaat homepage offering professional certification courses in data science, AI, cloud computing
- [Free Online Courses with Certificates - Intellipaat Academy](https://intellipaat.com/academy): Intellipaat Academy offering free online courses in data science, AWS, Python with certificates
- [Corporate Training Companies - Corporate Training Program Courses](https://intellipaat.com/corporate-training): Corporate training programs in AI, data science, cloud computing, cybersecurity for enterprises
- [Hire From Us - Intellipaat](https://intellipaat.com/hire-from-us): Hiring platform offering trained resources in data science, cloud, AI/ML at zero recruitment cost
